invariants.text: Order.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
An order must start in the pending state.
An order in the confirmed state cannot transition to cancelled.
An order in the shipped state cannot transition to cancelled.
An order in the cancelled state cannot transition to shipped.
An order in the pending state can transition to confirmed.
An order in the pending state can transition to shipped.
An order in the confirmed state can transition to shipped.
